note: VBOX used here for scoring only; S3b/S2 are development drives (tuned on), not validation

definitions.mean_err: mean horizontal error over frames with start_s <= t_s <= end_s (m)
definitions.end_err: error at the last frame of the window (m)
definitions.along_end: (est - ref) . reference direction of travel at the last frame, + = ahead (m)
definitions.cross_end: (est - ref) . left normal at the last frame, + = left (m)
definitions.path_ratio: path length of the frames / path length of the reference, both on the frame grid
definitions.inside: coverage: % of frames whose reference position is inside the reported 1-sigma ellipse (Mahalanobis <= 1); a calibrated 2-D filter gives ~39 %

method: check_outage.Truth + score_track (see score_export.py docstring for line citations)
